Applies to CEDICT-ZH-EN.mdx.
CC-CEDICT, the community-maintained free Chinese-English dictionary, is published by MDBG (https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/dictionary?page=cc-cedict, https://cc-cedict.org/wiki/) under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). The upstream file supplies this notice for its referenced work:
CEDICT - Copyright (C) 1997, 1998 Paul Andrew Denisowski
OpenMDict modified it: readings are grouped and reordered by headword, pinyin is shown with tone marks, cross-references are linked, and lookup redirects are added for Traditional, variant and punctuation-free spellings (preset-dicts/scripts/build_cedict_mdx.py). The release used is named in the dictionary's description. The modified data is shared under the same license.
